scope: 67 exact normalized source names searched across all original PBF node/way/relation current name fields and explicit alias/historical name fields; retained only by complete-object containment in same-snapshot Pecs municipality. Name evidence only.

notes: The latest URL is mutable; SHA256 identifies this exact snapshot.
MD5 verifies the publisher checksum; SHA256 pins the acquired bytes.
OSM community boundaries are not necessarily official legal boundaries.

municipalityGeometryReference.sourceScope: Current original OSM administrative reference for name-city association, not inferred quarter geometry or official/legal-boundary accuracy.

nameNormalization: Unicode NFD/casefold and retain alphanumeric characters; ignores diacritics/punctuation/spacing only. No substring, fuzzy, spelling substitution or nearest-point aliasing. Explicit multi-name tags split only on semicolon.
missingSourceRefInterpretation: Country-clipped nonlocal candidates with incomplete original references are retained as unresolved/excluded; no missing source coordinate or city association is invented.
